The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, though it could be a smaller side plate. The food on it is roasted broccoli rabe or broccolini, plus a small patty at the edge that may be a meat or grain patty, roughly 8 cm across.

I estimate the greens at about 90 g. They look charred and may have been cooked with oil, so I'd put them at around 80 kcal. The patty is thin and weighs about 60 g, and at roughly 200 kcal per 100 g it comes to about 120 kcal.

That gives about 150 g of food and roughly 200 kcal in total.
